title: HYBRID RAG SERVING FEASIBILITY GATE
verdict_rationale: No intended serving environment is identified anywhere in the repository (no deployment config, host spec, Dockerfile, CI, or IaC). Per the task's own guidance, the missing decision is documented and serving readiness is not claimed.

Encoder (BAAI/bge-m3) latency was NOT measured: torch/transformers absent, no GPU, model not cached, and the project's dependency policy is deliberately stdlib-only. Installing large packages would still yield unrepresentative 2-core CPU numbers, which the task forbids treating as production.

All retrieval-side work is complete and green: BM25/H3 latencies measured (pre-computed embeddings), fusion optimised (exact-equivalent, ~1.3x, adopted with regression tests), fallback observability verified, frozen-benchmark reproduction PASS, full test suite baseline-equal, artifact hashes intact, production default unchanged.
Because the serving environment (and its SLOs) is undecided, encoder latency and end-to-end serving feasibility remain UNRESOLVED regardless of the local retrieval-side measurements.

rollout_prerequisites: DECIDE the intended serving environment (host/instance class, GPU vs CPU, region, concurrency model) and document it.
ESTABLISH latency/resource SLOs (p50/p95/p99 retrieval, cold-start, memory, throughput) and obtain explicit approval.
MEASURE query-encoder latency in that environment (load bge-m3 rev 5617a9f, warm p50/p95/p99).
RE-MEASURE end-to-end H3_RRF20 including the encoder in that environment.
OPTIONALLY adopt the proven fusion optimisation in the serving deployment (already adopted in service.rrf_fuse_full).
Only then: a separate, explicit decision to flip SVK_RETRIEVAL_MODE=hybrid_rrf20 in the target environment, with the documented rollback ready.
rollback_plan: export SVK_RETRIEVAL_MODE=bm25 (or unset; configs/policy.toml [retrieval] mode stays bm25). Instant, lossless; next search() serves H1 BM25. Fallback-on-dense-failure also auto-serves BM25 with a logged reason if dense artifacts break.
